policy.active: Genuine activity protects healthy queued/running teaching regardless of total turn age or silence.
policy.cancelling: At learner inactivity, persist idleAt/releaseAt in idle_turn_cleanup and request cancellation. The deadline is anchored to last use and cannot slide with scans, restarts or heartbeats.
policy.safeRelease: Queued-only or acknowledged turns quiesce writers and checkpoint. After expiry checkpointing uses only the remaining lease; no second renewal follows the source snapshot.
policy.committedRelease: A short activity CAS commits releasing=true after a safe checkpoint. Return before that intent cancels release; return afterward completes deletion/recovery. Contention cannot erase the deadline or restart renewal.
policy.uncertainRelease: Unacknowledged running turns are durably cancelled and their leases revoked before discard intent/destruction. Previous checkpoint and loss notice remain.
policy.recovery: Real input clears only cancellable cleanup; already cancelled work requires explicit retry. Replacement binding clears old cleanup. Expired predecessor cleanup never suppresses renewal of a genuinely returning learner's pending replacement.
policy.faultBoundary: If the control database cannot persist fences/intents, intentional destructive release is refused and the remaining provider lease bounds compute.

implementation.leaseIdentity: Stable process ID for diagnostics, distinct random ID per claim; all runSession writes use its captured lease identity.
implementation.control: Short DB-only cleanup precedes project hydration and Study advisory admission; cancellation/write transactions lock Agent rows before Study rows.
implementation.activity: Returning input bypasses long teaching advisory locks; failure/discard/release writes validate current activity.
implementation.staleWriters: Readiness uses current intent; teaching commit compares discard/release snapshots; checkpoint head and recovery publication reject released bindings. Terminal input/resize check raw current owner/binding/intent after discovery and permissions under the environment mutex, immediately before provider dispatch.

fixes: Prevent same-process retry from reauthorizing an old worker after attempt reset.
Checkpoint safe queued/acknowledged edits after expiry instead of treating them as uncertain writes.
Reject stale interactive commits/readiness after concurrent discard.
Preserve cleanup through successful checkpoint and uncertain deletion.
Remove renewal using a stale decision after snapshot I/O.
Let returning activity cancel an in-flight uncommitted release, including failure paths.
Do not reinstall a stale failure clock after returning activity.
Scope retention expiry to the renewal target, so old release intent cannot expire a returning learner's restored replacement.
Cover both capacity and Study advisory-lock contention with deferred renewal.
Fence terminal input and resize after irreversible release/discard with a final raw Study check after terminal discovery and permission I/O; preserve Stop/control without long Study locking.

terminalFenceRegression.control: Stop remains available while the Study mutex is held; existing integration preserves normal terminal input under the same contention.

terminalFenceRegression.isolation: Every new fixture is destroyed in finally; an initial full run exposed accumulated mock capacity, corrected without raising the 100-environment limit.
